cards.front: The four attachment styles are secure, anxious-ambivalent, anxious-avoidant, and [___] — the last is associated with caregiver neglect or abuse and is the strongest predictor of later psychopathology.
cards.context:
Ainsworth's Strange Situation classifies attachment in 12-18 month infants by reaction to separation and reunion. Secure (60-65%): distress, rapid settling.

Disorganised (10-15%) — contradictory behaviours (approach then freeze) when the caregiver is both comfort and threat — is the strongest developmental predictor of BPD, dissociative disorders, and later psychopathology.

cards.front: Made-up words with personal meaning are called [___] and most commonly indicate psychosis.
cards.context:
Invented words ('the glorpenflam is calling me') carry private meaning. Almost pathognomonic for psychosis (schizophrenia spectrum).

Distinguish from aphasic paraphasias, where the word substitution is non-volitional and accompanied by other language deficits.
